name: Miho Kanna
source:
Daughter of the Panitec Group, a world famous and high-technology toy manufacturer. She has a very spoiled, arrogant, prideful, self-centered personality, to the point she plays with her maids as if they were toys and takes their virginities. She had a fleeting interest on the [url=/c63055]protagonist[/url] and asked [url=/c63046]Airi[/url] to introduce him. However Airi got jealous and refused and ended up unintentionally offending Kanna. 

Knowing that this could come back to harm Airi, [url=/c63047]Raichi[/url] seduced Kanna so she could prevent Kanna's rage and protect Airi.
